verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability documents ingesting metrics (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Elastic Agent), logs (single endpoint, Discover), and traces (APM across microservices) into one solution, which it describes as unifying logs, metrics, and traces. Cross-signal context is only implied: telemetry is described as 'tied' together, and the natural-language interface works 'without switching tabs or context'. missing for 10: explicit documentation of trace-to-log and metric-to-trace pivoting through shared identifiers or context, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the correlation workflow.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: Unify logs, metrics, traces, user experience data
Ingest metrics from any source using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus remote write, or Elastic Agent integrations.
Use **Discover** to search, filter, and tail all your logs ingested into your project in one place.
Elastic APM traces every request across microservices and APIs pinpointing code-level latency.
Real user monitoring and synthetic testing are tied to SLOs and back end telemetry.
Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
